decisive_items: A conserved splice-site mutation in SUFU gene (c.757-2A>G) in all tumor and normal tissue samples
buds and cords of basaloid cells enclosing small cystic spaces
Multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored papules located on the face and vulva
response.rationale: The combination of clinical and genetic findings, including the SUFU gene mutation and the presence of multiple dome-shaped papules, is more consistent with Nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome than Infundibulocystic Basal Cell Carcinoma

rejected.why: Lack of genetic findings to support the diagnosis
